title: COMP-2 — double-precision float; subject to the same HFP-vs-IEEE format question as COMP-1
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ACTUARIAL-PV.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> COMP-2 = double-precision float (8 bytes). Same HFP-vs-IEEE
      *> question as COMP-1 at higher resolution. Used heavily in
      *> actuarial/financial COBOL where 7 decimal digits aren't
      *> enough. A Java double port is bit-identical only when the
      *> mainframe was configured for IEEE mode.
       01  WS-PV    USAGE COMP-2.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           STOP RUN.
notes: COMP-2 is everywhere in financial/actuarial COBOL. The format question is the same as COMP-1 but the precision impact is amplified — present-value calculations propagating 1e-15 errors compound visibly over thousands of records.
